name: Inverse rule (simplified form)
summary: The scalar 2 (a Z-spider without legs) times two copies of 1/√2 (a Z- and X-spider joined by three wires) is the empty diagram.
description:
A Z-spider with no legs is the scalar 2, and a Z-spider and an X-spider connected by three wires is the scalar $\frac1{\sqrt2}$. Together the three components are the empty diagram.

This is the scalar axiom of the simplified stabilizer ZX-calculus of Backens, Perdrix and Wang. It plays the role of Backens' star rule (a dedicated generator for $\frac12$ that is inverse to the legless Z-spider), and is equivalent to the [inverse rule](../inverse-rule/) given the other axioms.
notes: The right-hand side is the empty diagram.
